(2) The scene moves to a brightly lit lingerie boutique with pink walls and white shelving. The woman is accompanied by an elderly woman with short gray hair, wearing a floral patterned vest over a red shirt and a face mask. They stand among racks of bras, and the younger woman points to various items while gesturing enthusiastically. (3) The younger woman holds up a beige wireless bra, physically stretching the band to demonstrate its elasticity to the viewer. She points to the sides of the garment to highlight specific comfort features. The grandmother stands beside her, touching the fabric of a light blue bra hanging on a rack. (4) The two continue browsing the store's extensive collection. The woman picks up various colorful bras in shades of pink and green, holding them up for comparison. The lighting is consistent bright studio-style indoor light, illuminating the smooth textures of the mannequin and the varied lace details of the products. (5) In a final indoor studio setting, the woman sits in front of a neutral wall with a yellow plush toy in the background. She talks directly to the camera with high energy, using frequent hand gestures. Extensive text overlays and promotional graphics appear around her, filling much of the screen's vertical space.
